integrity: Pinned Phase 10 seal verifies every listed immutable Phase 10 file; original rope and decoder hashes are checked. Compressed/raw trace fingerprints, original observer checkpoint addresses, execution dependencies and read-only Phase 10 analyzer assertions must all agree before export.

clock.cycle: Original native driver CPU-call index, not host wall clock
clock.t: cycle * 12 / 1024000 seconds, for replay positioning only
clock.observedClockSeconds: Original TIME2/TIME1 snapshot DP B28 centiseconds divided by 100; held at recorded observation
clock.epochSeconds: Initialized navigation state epoch, distinct from observed clock and replay position

frame.dsky: Original channel 010 digit fields PROG/VERB/NOUN/R1/R2/R3 reconstructed with retained Phase 1 decoder; sign lamps not decoded
frame.signedTimeToGoSeconds: Observed MPAC at original ROOTSTOR_RESULT (ROOTSTOR+4), DP fraction * 2^17 / 100; the later normal return and TTF store are separately verified by the subsequent QUADGUID continuation
frame.ignitionTimeSeconds: Original TIG DP B28 centiseconds at original IGNALGRT only; absolute synthetic mission time
frame.ignitionLeadSeconds: (TIG minus TIME2/TIME1) at the same IGNALGRT observation, held solution lead rather than ticking countdown
frame.rootCount: Count of observed original ROOTSTOR_RESULT solutions; each later normal return and TTF store is separately verified at QUADGUID. Missing-site has three provisional solutions before genuine 01406 failure
frame.alarms: Nonzero original FAILREG words, displayed as five octal digits
frame.stage: Educational annotation of actual recorded events, not a new AGC mode
frame.observationSources: Per-field source cycle and one-based decompressed raw JSONL line, plus original symbol/routine or packet details
frame.source: Actual recorded row that caused this held presentation state to be emitted

sampling: Frames occur only at actual recorded observations or events. All fields hold the latest observation with its source pointer. No interpolation, fabricated events or inferred trajectory.

initialState.positionM: Actual P27-stored RRECTLEM decoded at B27, Moon-centered basic REF inertial metres
initialState.velocityMps: Actual P27-stored VRECTLEM decoded at B5 metres/centisecond and multiplied by 100
initialState.landingSiteMoonFixedM: Actual RLS mission input at B27 metres; null if omitted
initialState.landingSiteBasicRefAtTlandM: Independent static M transpose * RLS using the documented nominal Moon matrix at TLAND, null if omitted
initialState.epochDistinction: Spacecraft is shown at initial state epoch 120 s; planned site direction is at nominal TLAND 784.4 s, not a simultaneous observation
initialState.scope: Static X-Z illustration of documented 3D inputs; no frontend authoritative physics, propagation or landing animation

limitations: Synthetic geometry and published preflight targets do not reproduce the historical Apollo 11 trajectory.
Numerically valid P51 matrix and original REFSMFLG do not establish physical alignment calibration.
No engine ignition, thrust plant, powered descent or landing is demonstrated.
Playback controls do not command a live AGC or accept arbitrary new mission parameters.
